title: StubHub Expands AI Ticket Discovery Push With New Claude Integration
key_facts: StubHub announced on a Thursday that fans can browse live event listings inside Anthropic's Claude AI assistant through Claude's connector framework.
Access covers StubHub's live marketplace data, including current pricing and seat-level availability; users are then sent to StubHub to complete the purchase.
It follows StubHub's previously announced ChatGPT app launch.
StubHub says this makes it the only major ticketing platform currently accessible across multiple leading AI assistants (a company claim).
Fans can see seat maps, pricing trends and section-level recommendations; completed transactions stay on StubHub and are backed by its FanProtect Guarantee.
Nayaab Islam, StubHub's President and Chief Product Officer, says the integrations ensure the marketplace reaches fans wherever they are.
TicketNews says StubHub has been aggressive on AI in 2026, including a ChatGPT integration and an AI-powered distribution product for artists, teams and venues.
quote_evidence: StubHub is extending its push into conversational ticket discovery, announcing Thursday that fans can now browse live event listings inside Anthropic’s Claude AI assistant through Claude’s connector framework.

StubHub said the Claude rollout makes it the only major ticketing platform currently accessible across multiple leading AI assistants, framing the strategy as a response to fans increasingly using conversational tools to search for live events.

The move follows StubHub’s previously announced ChatGPT app launch and further signals the company’s effort to make itself a default ticketing layer inside major AI assistants rather than relying solely on traditional web and app search behavior.
why_it_matters_hint: Ticket search is moving into AI assistants, but this particular integration is months old.
event_date: 23 Apr 2026 (Thursday). The TicketNews URL is dated /2026/04/ and a Business Wire release, 'StubHub Brings Live Event Discovery to Anthropic's Claude', is listed in Google News on 23 Apr 2026.
